name: AI Security Evaluation Methodology
description: Design and validation of reproducible security evaluations and benchmarks for AI systems. Covers selecting metrics such as attack success rate and robust accuracy, controlling for model non-determinism, statistical rigour and sample sizing, test-set contamination, and reporting results with stated uncertainty. Applies ISO/IEC 17025-style method validation and validity monitoring to AI security testing; the attacks themselves are covered by AIML-ADV-ROBUST and AIML-LLM-REDTEAM.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to AI security evaluation methodology

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands why AI security results are hard to reproduce and compare
evidence: Can explain sources of variance such as sampling temperature, model updates, and prompt formatting
Aware of benchmark contamination and its effect on reported results
Understands common metrics such as attack success rate, robust accuracy, and refusal rate

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Can run established AI security evaluations reproducibly under guidance
evidence: Runs an existing benchmark with fixed model versions, seeds, and configuration recorded
Repeats trials to estimate run-to-run variance
Reports results with confidence intervals using a provided template

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently designs and validates AI security evaluations
evidence: Designs evaluations with defined metrics, sample sizes, and success criteria before execution
Applies appropriate statistical tests and intervals for comparing models or defences
Checks test sets for contamination and grader reliability, including LLM-as-judge agreement
Produces evaluation reports stating method, uncertainty, and limits of validity

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Builds evaluation programmes and benchmarks; validates methods; mentors others
evidence: Builds and maintains internal AI security benchmarks with versioning and held-out sets
Validates evaluation methods for fitness for purpose and documents validation records
Designs interlaboratory or cross-team comparisons of AI security results
Reviews and calibrates evaluation designs across the team

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines the lab's AI evaluation practice; shapes external benchmarks
evidence: Established the lab's AI security evaluation and method validation procedures
Published research on AI security evaluation methodology or benchmark design
Trains teams on rigorous AI security evaluation
Contributes to external benchmarks or standards for AI evaluation

assessment_methods.description: Given two guardrail configurations and an attack prompt set, design and run an evaluation that determines whether their difference in attack success rate is statistically significant
Review an AI security evaluation report for metric definition, recorded configuration, contamination checks, and correctly stated uncertainty
